entries.name: line-currency-path-not-parent
entries.claim: A stored currency path is admitted only as the line's own parent link.

kills.name: the report source refuses a currency path that is not the line parent link
kills.expected: a two-hop currency path was admitted

entries.name: line-header-currency-undeclared
entries.claim: A line amount read through the path reads a declared currency field of the header.

kills.name: a header currency read through the path must be a declared currency field of the header
kills.expected: an undeclared header currency was bound

entries.name: line-retired-currency-any-type
entries.claim: Only the holding record type's own retired currency field stays bound unvalidated (slice-1 follow-up).

kills.name: a retired currency field of another record type is not skipped as bound
kills.expected: another record type's retired currency was skipped

entries.name: line-floor-not-raised
entries.claim: A logical field on a line table, or an amount read through a path, raises the floor to the line rung.

kills.name: the line rung: line declarations and header-read currencies need it, nothing else does
kills.expected: a line declaration did not raise the floor

entries.name: line-rung-unexplained
entries.claim: Serving refuses the line rung on a release without line logical fields.

kills.name: the line rung: line declarations and header-read currencies need it, nothing else does
kills.expected: an unexplained line rung was served

entries.name: line-allowed-texts-contract-unchecked
entries.claim: Admission refuses a write contract whose allowedTexts differ from the field's declared allowed values (slice-1 follow-up).

kills.name: the write contracts must carry exactly the declared allowed values
kills.expected: a contract without its declared codes was admitted

entries.name: line-header-suffix-ignored
entries.claim: A line amount shows the currency its header stores, never its own row's.

kills.name: a line amount shows its header's currency, and says so without the header
kills.expected: a line amount ignored its header's currency

entries.name: line-editor-header-dropped
entries.claim: The document editor's line cell reads its header's currency.

kills.name: a line amount shows its header's currency, and says so without the header
kills.expected: the editor line cell lost its header currency

entries.name: line-source-not-joined
entries.claim: The header currency a line amount reads is a line source, so a changed code re-renders the lines.

kills.name: the editor refreshes lines when the header currency they read changes
kills.expected: the header currency is not a line source

entries.name: line-v1-report-reads-path
entries.claim: A v1 report body never reads a currency through a path (that is a line-grain report).

kills.name: a v1 report never reads a currency through a path
kills.expected: a v1 body read a header currency

entries.name: line-header-path-not-written
entries.claim: Customize writes a line amount's header currency with the parent-link path.

kills.name: a line table holds every logical kind; line money reads a fixed, a line or a header currency
kills.expected: a line amount lost its header currency path

entries.name: line-long-text-not-multiline
entries.claim: A line long-text field is edited in a text area.

kills.name: a line table holds every logical kind; line money reads a fixed, a line or a header currency
kills.expected: a line long-text field is not a text area

entries.name: line-approval-text-generic
entries.claim: The approval text names the header whose currency a line amount is in.

kills.name: the approval text names the header's currency for a line amount
kills.expected: the approval text lacks "Rate (money in the Work order's Currency (CAD, USD, EUR))"

entries.name: line-activation-rung-unexplained
entries.claim: Activation refuses the line rung on a release without line logical fields.

kills.name: release admission refuses a line logical release below the line rung, and the line rung without one
kills.expected: the line rung without line fields
